name: British Grand Prix 2020
description: A masterclass in wet-to-dry transitions. Hamilton led from pole while nursing a puncture on the final lap to claim victory — a moment of sheer willpower.

name: Bahrain Grand Prix 2014
description: The greatest duel of the hybrid era. Hamilton and Rosberg traded fastest laps in a breathless finale that redefined teammate rivalry.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2021
description: The championship decided on the final lap of the final race. A moment that will be debated for generations — a lap that changed Formula 1 history.

name: Bahrain Grand Prix 2021
description: The first salvo in the greatest championship battle in a generation. Verstappen's raw pace against Hamilton's championship experience — the war begins.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 1995
description: Schumi at his rain-soaked, supernatural best. Threading a Ferrari through Eau Rouge at the limit while others lifted — this was pure dominance.

name: Japanese Grand Prix 2000
description: The moment Schumacher equalled Senna's three titles with Ferrari. An emotional, fist-pumping celebration that symbolised a generation's passing of the torch.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 1984
description: Perhaps the single greatest lap in Formula 1 history. Senna in a Toleman was pulling 10 seconds a lap faster than race leader Prost before the red flag fell.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 1991
description: Senna crossed the line unable to lift his arms after driving the final laps with just one gear. Sheer grit and national pride fused into one iconic victory.

name: Italian Grand Prix 1985
description: The Professor at his smoothest. A tactical masterpiece at the temple of speed — Prost managing tyres, fuel, and rivals with cold precision to claim the title.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 1987
description: First grand prix in the Eastern Bloc. Prost navigated the tortuous Hungaroring circuit with surgical efficiency, reading the race five moves ahead.

name: Italian Grand Prix 1976
description: Six weeks after the inferno at the Nürburgring. Lauda returned, eyes bandaged, barely able to blink — and finished fourth. The most courageous drive in history.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2006
description: Alonso in his championship-winning Renault, dancing through Monaco's streets. A display of qualifying perfection that echoed the ghosts of Senna.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2008
description: A Renault at the temple of speed. Alonso's victory in machinery not designed for Monza remains one of the most stunning drives of the modern era.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 2012
description: Vettel won the championship despite a first-lap puncture and a recovery drive from last. Sixth place was enough. Three titles in three years — a dynasty complete.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2011
description: Vettel on rails through Eau Rouge, Blanchimont, and the Pouhon in one of F1's most technically demanding circuits. Dominant from lights to flag.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2019
description: Leclerc held off both Mercedes for lap after lap to deliver Ferrari's first home win at Monza in nine years. The tifosi flooded the track in red delirium.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2024
description: The home win he had chased his whole life. Leclerc converted pole into victory on the streets of his birthplace — an emotional exorcism of years of Monaco heartbreak.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2024
description: Maiden victory at last. After 110 starts, Norris took the lead and never looked back — McLaren's resurgence announced to the world under the Florida sun.

name: São Paulo Grand Prix 2022
description: Russell controlled a Mercedes one-two from the front at Interlagos for his maiden Grand Prix win — the breakthrough that confirmed a future champion had arrived.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2023
description: The race that ended Red Bull's perfect season. Sainz managed his tyres and the DRS train with surgical control under the lights to break a record 15-race win streak.

name: Japanese Grand Prix 2022
description: A rain-soaked masterclass at Suzuka that sealed Verstappen's second world title. Untouchable in the wet, he won by nearly half a minute on a shortened race.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2020
description: Pole by nearly a second, lights-to-flag domination, and a record-equalling eighth win at a single circuit. Hamilton at the absolute peak of his powers.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2021
description: Amid late-race chaos on the streets of Baku, Pérez kept his head while others lost theirs to claim a famous victory and announce his value to Red Bull.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2018
description: Redemption two years in the making. Ricciardo nursed a power-stricken car for 50 laps to convert a record-breaking pole into the win that got away in 2016.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2021
description: A McLaren one-two at the temple of speed, and the Honey Badger back on top after years in the wilderness. A shoey on the Monza podium completed the fairy tale.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2020
description: The most improbable win of the modern era. Months after being dropped by Red Bull, Gasly held off McLaren to the line at Monza for an unforgettable maiden victory.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2021
description: Ocon led every lap and withstood relentless pressure from a four-time champion behind to convert chaos into the maiden Grand Prix win of his career.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2024
description: Composure beyond his years. Piastri controlled the Hungaroring to take his maiden victory, confirming McLaren had unearthed a future champion.

name: Barcelona Grand Prix 2026
description: Hamilton's first victory in Ferrari red. A commanding display at the Circuit de Catalunya — controlled pace, immaculate tyre management, and the calm of a seven-time champion writing a new chapter in scarlet.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2026
description: A statement carved into the streets of Monte Carlo. Antonelli put his Mercedes on pole and never looked back — a pole-to-flag victory that announced Formula 1's next great talent in the sport's most unforgiving arena.

name: Japanese Grand Prix 1988
description: Senna clinched his first world championship at Suzuka, recovering from a near-stall at the start to carve through the field — the drive that announced a legend.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 2008
description: The most dramatic title decider in history — Hamilton snatched the place he needed at the final corner of the final lap to win his first championship by a single point.

name: Brazilian Grand Prix 2016
description: A wet-weather masterclass — Verstappen sliced from sixteenth to third in the closing laps with a series of overtakes that defied the conditions and physics alike.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2022
description: From fourteenth on the grid to a crushing win — Verstappen carved through the field at Spa with a pace advantage that made the rest of the grid look static.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 1994
description: Schumacher mastered the streets of Monaco for the first time — a flawless lights-to-flag drive that confirmed his command of the sport's most demanding circuit.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2003
description: Alonso's maiden Grand Prix victory — at the time the youngest winner in F1 history. A controlled, mature drive on a circuit that rewards precision over power.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2019
description: Leclerc's first Formula 1 win, held under relentless late pressure from Hamilton — dedicated to his friend Anthoine Hubert, who had died at the circuit a day earlier.

name: Italian Grand Prix 2008
description: The youngest race winner in F1 history — Vettel converted a shock wet pole into a faultless Toro Rosso victory at the Temple of Speed.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2010
description: Alonso converted pole into a controlled lights-to-flag win under the Marina Bay lights, holding off Vettel through every safety-car restart to keep his title fight alive.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2013
description: A crushing display of dominance — Vettel disappeared from pole to win by over thirty seconds, lapping all but the podium on his way to a fourth straight title.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2018
description: Hamilton's pole lap at Marina Bay was hailed as one of the greatest of his career — a banzai effort he converted into a title-defining victory under the lights.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2022
description: Pérez drove a faultless race under the lights, controlling two late safety-car restarts and surviving a track-limits investigation to take a commanding win.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris dominated from pole on the revised Marina Bay layout, pulling clear under the lights for a statement win that cut deep into the championship lead.

name: Spanish Grand Prix 2016
description: On his Red Bull debut, the eighteen-year-old held off two Ferraris under relentless pressure to become the youngest race winner in Formula 1 history.

name: Spanish Grand Prix 2013
description: A home win for Alonso in front of a delirious Spanish crowd — a bold four-stop strategy executed to perfection as he carved through the field to the front.

name: Spanish Grand Prix 2004
description: Peak Ferrari dominance — Schumacher led from pole on a circuit that exposes any weakness, untouchable on his way to a record-breaking seventh world title.

name: British Grand Prix 2022
description: Sainz's maiden Grand Prix victory on his 150th start — he held off a charging Leclerc and Pérez after a late safety car to win an epic British Grand Prix.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2014
description: Hamilton sealed his second world title in the double-points finale, leading from pole under the Yas Marina lights as his title rival's car faltered behind him.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2010
description: The youngest world champion in history — Vettel won the finale from pole and snatched the title from three rivals who all faltered when it mattered most.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris closed the season with a commanding lights-to-flag win at Yas Marina, sealing McLaren's first constructors' title in twenty-six years.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2017
description: From seventeenth to the top step amid red flags and chaos — Ricciardo carved through the wreckage of a frantic Baku street race for one of the great improbable wins.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018
description: Handed the lead by a late puncture for Bottas, Hamilton pounced to win a wild Baku race he had looked set to lose — a swing of fortune that reshaped the title fight.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2022
description: Pole position number four of the season at Baku — Leclerc's qualifying lap was untouchable on the streets, leading commandingly before an engine failure ended his race.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2022
description: Red Bull dominance on the Baku straights — Verstappen swept past his rivals into the lead and cruised away, stretching his championship advantage with ruthless ease.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018
description: Vettel led from pole and looked set for victory until a late safety-car restart — a lock-up into Turn 1 cost him the race, a costly moment in a tightening title fight.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2023
description: From ninth on the grid to a commanding win — Verstappen carved through the field on the Miami straights to underline a season of total dominance.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2022
description: Pole position for the inaugural Miami Grand Prix — Leclerc led a Ferrari front-row lockout around the new Autodrome before Red Bull's race pace told.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2022
description: A measured drive to the podium at the first Miami Grand Prix — Sainz backed up the Ferrari front row with a controlled third place on the bumpy street-style layout.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2023
description: Pérez converted pole into the early lead at Miami and looked set for the win before his charging team-mate swept past — a sign of the title fight slipping away.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2025
description: A controlled McLaren one-two led home by Piastri — he managed the pace at the front through the Miami heat to take a statement win in the championship fight.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2021
description: Pole, fastest lap and a lights-to-flag win at Red Bull's home race — Verstappen was untouchable at the Red Bull Ring, the high point of a dominant championship run.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2022
description: Leclerc beat Verstappen in a straight fight, passing him three times as a throttle issue bit late — a rare 2022 weekend where Ferrari's pace held to the flag.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2024
description: Handed the lead when the leaders collided, Russell pounced to take a surprise Mercedes win at the Red Bull Ring after a tense late-race scrap.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2016
description: A last-lap collision with his title rival settled it Hamilton's way — he held on to win at the Red Bull Ring after contact at the final corner.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris hunted down the lead and was wheel-to-wheel for the win until a clash with Verstappen ended his charge — a what-might-have-been at the Red Bull Ring.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2019
description: Hamilton inherited the lead through a Virtual Safety Car cycle and controlled it to the flag at Sochi — a strategic Mercedes win on his way to a sixth title.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: From the back of the grid to second in the closing laps — Verstappen's late call for intermediates as the rain arrived turned a damage-limitation day into a points coup.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: A maiden pole and a long-awaited first win in sight — Norris led at Sochi until late rain caught McLaren out, a heartbreaking what-might-have-been.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: Sainz led his home-from-home Ferrari into the early lead at Sochi and held on for a podium, a high point of his first season in red.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2019
description: Pole position and the early lead for Leclerc at Sochi, part of a blistering late-2019 run of qualifying performances in the Ferrari.

name: Malaysian Grand Prix 2017
description: Verstappen swept past Hamilton on lap four and drove away to a commanding win at Sepang — a statement drive on his nineteenth birthday weekend.

name: Malaysian Grand Prix 2014
description: A lights-to-flag win from pole at Sepang — Hamilton's Mercedes was untouchable, the start of the run that defined the 2014 title.

name: Malaysian Grand Prix 2013
description: "Multi-21" — Vettel ignored team orders to pass Webber and win at Sepang, a ruthless, controversial victory that soured a Red Bull weekend.

name: Malaysian Grand Prix 2012
description: A masterclass in the wet — Alonso wrung a win out of an uncompetitive Ferrari at a rain-hit Sepang, the drive that launched an against-the-odds title fight.

name: Malaysian Grand Prix 2016
description: Ricciardo held off his team-mate through a tense finish at Sepang for a popular win, after Hamilton's leading Mercedes expired in flames.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2009
description: A throwback win in a difficult Ferrari — Räikkönen used KERS and raw pace down the Kemmel straight to hold off Giancarlo Fisichella's Force India for victory at Spa.

name: Japanese Grand Prix 2005
description: One of the great drives — from seventeenth on the grid, Räikkönen carved through the field and took the lead with a last-lap pass on Fisichella into Turn 1 at Suzuka.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2014
description: Pole and a controlled lights-to-flag win on the streets of Monaco — Rosberg's command of the principality, where he won three years running, was absolute.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2016
description: Second place was all he needed and second place is what he managed — through enormous late pressure, Rosberg held his nerve at Yas Marina to clinch the 2016 World Championship.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: An instant classic on the Strip — a first-corner clash and a five-second penalty only set up a wheel-to-wheel duel with Leclerc that Verstappen won under the neon, the standout drive of a record-breaking season.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: Pole position and a last-lap pass on Pérez for second — Leclerc lit up Las Vegas' dazzling debut, taking the fight to Verstappen down the Strip all night long.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: A charging drive through the pack under the lights — Pérez fought onto the inaugural Las Vegas podium before being pipped for second on the very last lap.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2024
description: Pole and a commanding lights-to-flag win on the Strip, leading a Mercedes one-two on a cold Vegas night as Verstappen sealed the title behind him.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2024
description: A storming drive to second under the Vegas lights, completing a Mercedes one-two on a cold night that finally lit up the Silver Arrows.

name: Saudi Arabian Grand Prix 2024
description: Eighteen years old, no practice, dropped into a sick Carlos Sainz's Ferrari on the morning of qualifying at one of the fastest street circuits on earth — Bearman answered with a composed run to seventh and points on his Formula 1 debut.

name: Canadian Grand Prix 2014
description: Ricciardo's maiden Grand Prix win — chasing down the leaders in the closing laps at Montréal, the breakthrough that announced him as a genuine front-runner.

name: Canadian Grand Prix 2017
description: A flawless pole-to-flag win in Montréal that drew Hamilton level with Ayrton Senna's career pole tally — Canada has always been his happiest hunting ground.

name: Dutch Grand Prix 2021
description: Home heaven for the Orange Army — Verstappen controlled his home Grand Prix at a reborn, banked Zandvoort to retake the championship lead.

name: Dutch Grand Prix 2024
description: A statement drive — Norris hunted down and passed Verstappen at his own home race, then pulled clear to win by over twenty seconds at Zandvoort.

name: United States Grand Prix 2018
description: The Iceman's fairy tale — Räikkönen ended a 113-race victory drought with a tactical masterclass in Austin, proof the raw speed had never left.

name: United States Grand Prix 2015
description: Title number three, sealed in style — Hamilton fought through a chaotic, rain-soaked Austin race, passing Rosberg late to clinch the championship at COTA.

name: Mexico City Grand Prix 2021
description: A perfect launch into Turn 1 and never seen again — Verstappen dominated at altitude in Mexico City to stretch his title lead with a near-faultless drive.

name: Mexico City Grand Prix 2022
description: Deafening grandstands willing him on — Pérez delivered the home podium Mexico craved, third at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez before his adoring crowd.

name: Emilia-Romagna Grand Prix 2022
description: A weekend sweep in Ferrari's backyard — Verstappen took pole, the sprint and a commanding wet-to-dry win at Imola, silencing the Tifosi.

name: San Marino Grand Prix 2004
description: Ferrari supremacy on Italian soil — Schumacher's San Marino win at Imola was another link in the most dominant season the sport had ever seen.

name: Australian Grand Prix 2022
description: A grand slam in Melbourne — pole, fastest lap, every lap led and a runaway win. Leclerc's perfect weekend at Albert Park was Ferrari at its 2022 peak.

name: Australian Grand Prix 2025
description: A cool head in chaos — Norris mastered a treacherous wet-dry season opener at Albert Park to win, the ideal start to a title campaign.

name: British Grand Prix 2025
description: The longest wait in Formula 1 history, finally over — after a record number of starts without a podium, Hülkenberg charged from nineteenth to third in a chaotic wet British Grand Prix to claim his first rostrum at last.

name: Belgian Grand Prix 2000
description: The greatest overtake of his generation — Häkkinen swept around Schumacher at over 320 km/h, both cars either side of a backmarker through Les Combes, and went on to win at Spa with the cool precision that defined the Flying Finn.

name: Monaco Grand Prix 2010
description: Pole and a faultless lights-to-flag win on the streets of Monaco — the second leg of Webber's back-to-back triumphs that briefly carried him to the top of the 2010 World Championship.
